interface.longDescription: Hosted cursor-box-channel HTTP Streamable MCP for ask, list_replies, heartbeat, claim, and reply, plus an optional Cloudflare Access console at https://channel.termolo.com/console. This Codex overlay omits mcpServers so ChatGPT GitHub import is not Desktop only. Live ChatGPT tools use Create MCP plugin; hosted /mcp stays Origin Bearer. Desktop Cursor/Claude/Grok keep mcp.json and CURSOR_BOX_MCP_TOKEN.
interface.defaultPrompt: Ask the cursor-box-channel and wait for a reply.
